Name: access right
Notes: right to consume a Public Transport service or other service provided along with the transport

Name: account based ticketing
Notes: fare collection paradigm which manages ticket issuing and validation through individual customer accounts held online and controlled by means of a token used on paper or electronic materialisations of a travel document

Name: activation
Notes: triggering of the use of access rights and initiation of consumption

Name: anonymous customer
Notes: CUSTOMER whose identity is not visible from their TRAVEL DOCUMENT, but who may be nevertheless be a registered customer using an anonymous token, in contrast to an impersonal customer, of whom the service operator has no individual knowledge

Name: automated fare collection system
Notes: fare collection system capable of automatically determining which products the customer must purchase according to the travel he consumes

Name: base price
Notes: price that is provided as a fixed absolute amount and from which other prices may be derived

Name: booking
Notes: placing of a reservation to use a specific transport service, but not necessarily entailing a purchase of a ticket

Name: blacklist
Notes: revenue protection mechanism taking the form of a security list identifying travel documents, media, etc. for which the validity has been cancelled temporarily (denial) or permanently (refusal) and which will be used to block access to services for customers bearing documents associated with items on the list

Name: cancellation
Notes: marking of a TRAVEL DOCUMENT as having been used

Name: capping
Notes: setting of an upper limit on the price of the consumption of access rights within a certain period

Name: card-centric
Notes: form of media centric ticketing where the media is a smart card

Name: classical ticketing
Notes: non-electronic fare management and ticketing using paper and passive media travel documents, usually for a single operator and for simple products such as single tips, return trips or period passes.

Name: control
Notes: checking of a passengerâ€™s entitlement to consume access rights, involving identification of the traveller and/or the travel rights

Name: consumption
Notes: using up of access right by a transport customer as a result of travel

Name: credentials
Notes: data or other mechanisms used to authenticate an actor to a system as a legitimate participant

Name: derived price
Notes: price that can be computed from another base price using pricing parameters and a pricing rule

Name: distributor
Notes: party who sells products on behalf of other product owners

Name: dynamic price
Notes: price that is fetched at run time from a pricing engine as opposed to a static or derived price

Name: easement
Notes: change to the normal access rights given to passengers because of a disruption to the network

Name: embargo date
Notes: date before which information about a price or product is not to be released to the public

Name: fare
Notes: from the customer perspective, the amount that a customer has to pay for a journey or for acquiring a specific fare product

Name: fare set
Notes: particular version of all aspects of the fare structure, i.e., of the rules and associated parameter values, also called a â€˜tariff

Name: fare structure
Notes: set of parameters that determine the basic tariffs

Name: fare token
Notes: materialisation of a travel document, i.e. ticket, as an anonymous physical object, such as a coin-like object that is captured at validation and subsequently reused; or an ephemeral paper representation that is cancelled

Name: flat faret
Notes: fare that does not increase in proportion to distance or other measure of consumption (and so typically cannot be derived by calculation)

Name: fulfilment
Notes: delivery of a TRAVEL DOCUMENT to the customer once it has been ordered or purchased

Name: graduated fare
Notes: type of progressive fare, i.e., one that increases in proportion to consumption, where the increase is based in a distance increment

Name: identity token
Notes: secure, machine-readable instantiation in media of an identity

Name: impersonal customer
Notes: CUSTOMER whose identity is not known in any way to the operator, for example the purchaser of a paper metro ticket

Name: interlining trip
Notes: customer trip made using a single medium and/or fare product that starts in one PT network and ends in another, in contrast to a local trip or a roaming trip

Name: interoperable fare management system
Notes: fare system which is interoperable with other fare systems, possessing all the functions involved in the fare management process such as management of application, products, security and certification, registration, and identification to enable customers to travel with participating service operators using a single portable electronic medium

Name: inventory controlled product
Notes: FARE PRODUCT whose supply is constrained by the service provider, such that only a set quota of capacity is available on a given journey

Name: local trip
Notes: trip made entirely within the home network of a fare product

Name: local use fare product
Notes: fare productÂ Â which can only be used on the operator’s own network, in contrast to a roaming product

Name: marking
Notes: stamping or defacing a travel document to indicate that it has been activated and its rights consumed or partially consumed

Name: media
Notes: physical support containing a machine readable/writable data/processor application, such as transport industry smartcards, payment industry contactless cards, public sector issued cards, mobile phones or paper (for barcodes), new formats such as watches and key fobs, plus NFC mobile

Name: media centric ticketing
Notes: ticketing paradigm under which the product sold is held entirely on some form of local media and any validation and charging is done immediately against the cardâ€™s contents

Name: pay as you go
Notes: type of reusable fare product giving the right to travel where the user is charged for access rights at the point of consumption or sometime after completing consumption,

Name: post-paid ticketing
Notes: type of fare management according to which the user is charged at some time after using the transport service

Name: prepaid ticketing
Notes: type of fare management according to which the user is charged for either a fare product (ticket) or a deposit prior to riding

Name: price
Notes: value of fare or tariff

Name: progressive fare
Notes: fare that increases in proportion to consumption of space and/or time

Name: registration
Notes: enrolment of a customer as a user of a fare system

Name: retailer

Each instantiation of this entity gives the number of items of one TYPE OF EQUIPMENT a VEHICLE MODEL should contain for a given PURPOSE OF EQUIPMENT PROFILE.
